items.title: 8.15 Equilibrium par catalyst ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.15, printed page 182.

blocks.title: Catalyst
blocks.text: Catalyst woh madda hai jo khud kharch hue baghair kimiyai reaction ki rate barhata hai. Yeh reaction ki equilibrium position ya equilibrium constant nahi badalta; yeh equilibrium pane ki raftar tez karta hai, to reaction ki yield wahi rehti hai.

blocks.alt: Reversible reaction ka energy profile. Baghair catalyst raasta (neela) ki activated state oonchi, catalyst wala (surkh) neechi. Dohre teer Ea (baghair catalyst) aur Ea' (catalyst) dikhate hain, aur reactants aur products ke darmiyan delta H wahi rehta hai. Note kehta hai aage aur peechhe dono rukawatein kam hoti hain, is liye equilibrium jaldi aata hai magar us ki jagah nahi badalti.
blocks.caption: Reversible reactions par catalyst ka asar (Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Catalyst kam activation energy ka naya rasta deta hai. Reaction coordinate ke muqable potential energy ke graph par catalyst ki maujoodgi mein curve ki intiha neechi hoti hai: uncatalysed reaction ki activation energy Ea ki jagah catalysed ke liye chhoti Ea' aati hai, forward aur reverse dono reactions ke liye, jabke reactants aur products ki energies, aur yun delta H, be-tabdeel rehti hain.

blocks.prompt: Contact process ke SO2 aur O2 mixture mein V2O5 shamil karne se SO3 kahin tez banta hai. Kya yeh SO3 ki equilibrium yield barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Catalyst forward aur reverse dono reactions ki activation energy barabar ghatata hai, to equilibrium jaldi pohnchta hai magar usi position par; equilibrium par yield aur Kp be-tabdeel hain. Yield sirf darja hararat, dabao ya concentrations badal kar barhai ja sakti hai.

items: Catalyst dono simton ke liye Ea ghata kar equilibrium tak pohnchne ko tez karta hai, magar position, constant aur yield be-tabdeel chhorta hai (Figure 8.3).
